brief: A small display stand: three bases meeting at a corner with a raised platform on a spike at that corner.

requirements.requirement: Three bases meeting at a corner
requirements.evidence: Three full bases piece:0,0,0, piece:1,0,0 and piece:1,-1,0 in one group, meeting at the shared junction 0,0|1,-1|1,0; lockJoints added 3 joint bolts and capOpenFaces capped open faces.

requirements.requirement: A raised platform on a spike at that corner
requirements.evidence: Mount spike spike:0#0,0|1,-1|1,0 at the shared corner, converted from solid per configurator steps, fitted with platform-lrg (setSpikeAccessory platform).

The raised large platform at the corner is the display surface; check_build ok, meshClash clear. Platform takes no direct prop prop placement (spike ref refused props), so it is presented empty as the stand itself.

finish.summary: Built a compact corner display stand: three full bases (0,0; 1,0; 1,-1) meeting at one junction, with a mount spike at that corner carrying a large raised platform. Open faces capped and joints locked per house rules. check_build passes with meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Three bases at a corner with a spiked platform — first I'll check the current build and where bases and spikes can fit.

result.note: A spike stands where three bases meet at a corner: place three bases around one junction first. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

Fix or drop the refused op and send the batch again (a refusal with details.steps gives the whole batch with it fixed: send those ops as one apply); refs and offers from this batch do not exist.

events.text: The platform is on. Now I'll find a small display item that will sit visibly on it.

outcomes.message: props stand on a piece, cover, cap, bin or drawer, or in a bolt-on, notch or bay bin; not on a spike.

result.note: ok covers rule errors only. meshClash must read "clear" for the meshes to be checked and clear.
